scripts.dev: concurrently -n "frontend,backend" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run start -w backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('frontend/dist')) { if (fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.rmSync('dist', {recursive:true, force:true}); fs.renameSync('frontend/dist', 'dist'); }"
